'''Metellos 3''' was an airless [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]].

==History==
The [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was notable for its collection of telescopic devices, which at one point, had attracted only academics and occasional tourists trying to escape the overcrowded [[Planet/Legends|planet]] below. But when the exploration of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] began anew after the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], locals discovered that they could use the devices to discover and explore new astronomical bodies.

With the co-operation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Metellos 3 became the first of several "[[planetary futures exchange]]s," offering the rights to the newly discovered astronomical objects. Since expeditions to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] worlds were quite expensive, the investors wanted to know the risk and potential reward in advance. The [[Metellos Exchange]] provided this information, based on the astronomical data gathered, and then auctioned the claims.

In [[3963 BBY]], its market and lavish suites attracted financiers from every corner of the Republic.
